cheapest_decisive_test.action: scripts/run_t20260929_35_overnight_persistence.py panel (DuckDB dv21, sanitized wide panel cache) then screen (5 signals x 2 pools x {LS decile, LO top20}, five windows, ordinary and Newey-West t, 100-seed same-pool placebo for the decision, second and all LS cells, six cost contracts, diagnostics (a)-(f), by-year, mechanical tier), under run_capped 1.8G; results.json.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: Decision cell ON21_P1500_LS in the 2024-01-08..2026-09-29 window has gross mean m < 8 bp/night, or Newey-West t < 2.0, or placebo beat < 0.90 (closed). The second cell ON5_P1500_LS is then judged the same way with t >= 2.5. Both closed closes the tug-of-war family.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: Decision cell: m >= 16 bp/night (net >= 0 at 2x auction cost, borrow deducted), Newey-West t >= 2.0, placebo beat >= 0.90. Marginal 8 <= m < 16 with t and beat passing goes to official-auction-price sampling only.

cost_and_execution_assumptions: Auction contract 2 bp per side (2x stress 4 bp): closing-auction cls order before 15:50 ET in, DAY market or opg before 09:28 ET out (Alpaca orders docs, opened 2026-09-30). Shorts charged T-32 borrow tiers by dv21 (dv21 $5-20M 5%/yr, $20-100M 2%/yr, >=$100M 0.5%/yr; calendar days/360; Friday nights count 3 days) although Alpaca charges $0 on ETB shares. Continuous-auction path (15:59 market buy, 09:30 market sell) reported separately: 0.5 x AR spread + 2 bp per side (1x), 1.0 x + 4 bp (2x). Frozen 10/20 bp per side reported only, not in the decision. Paper caveat: paper opg fills unreliable (45 of 50 expired 2026-09-15), cls untested on paper.
existing_solution_comparison: Lou-Polk-Skouras 2019 (JFE): overnight decile long/short about 3.47%/month, about 16 bp/night; Aboody et al. 2018 (JFQA): 1.76 percentage points per week, about 35 bp/night; Lachance 2023: past-year overnight return is the best predictor of future overnight returns. All are cost-blind raw returns with first-print or official opens. This repo has two signal cards on the same signals predicting close-to-close returns (overnight_mom_21 IC -0.017, t -1.43; intraday_rev_21 flat), which is the tug of war itself. Nobody opened here tests the overnight-only hold with auction execution on a 2024-26 liquid pool with a same-pool placebo. Reuse: T-32 pool hygiene, split filter, borrow tiers, DTC proxy; T-11 official close identical to daily close.
negative_experiments_checked: oc research directions check overnight persistence auction (2026-09-30): dir:overnight_intraday_gap_retail_pwb (fixed overnight hold, refuted; different mechanism, no ranking on past overnight returns) and dir:cross_sectional_gap_fade (refuted at T-32; auction check closed the >=$20M tiers at 7.09 bp/day, C1b closed the small-cap gap-down long at -5.4 bp/day, T-20260930-11 and T-20260930-12). Signal cards overnight_mom_21 and intraday_rev_21 tested close-to-close only. Difference: the leg held is only close to next open, entered and exited in auctions, ranked by past overnight persistence rather than the current gap.
objective: T-20260929-35 (C2a): in 2024-01-08..2026-09-29, do top-1500 dollar-volume US common stocks ranked by past overnight return (ON_5/21/63/252, TOW_21) keep a next-night close-to-open long/short edge of at least 16 bp/night gross, with Newey-West t >= 2 and a same-pool random placebo beat >= 0.90, so that two auction legs with no quoted spread can pay the cost?

remaining_evidence_gap: Open price basis: daily-bar open versus the official opening auction print may have a thicker tail in the selected high-overnight-volatility names than T-11 sampled; a marginal or pass tier requires a 400-name official-price sample first. Earnings nights are part of overnight returns and are diagnostic only. Survivorship: data/sip-delisted merged, with-and-without differences reported. Not measured: opening-auction impact of our orders, cls and opg fill reliability on the paper account, ETB availability of individual shorts.

sources.applicability: Sets the 16 bp/night gross magnitude that the decision cell must reach; supplies the tug-of-war signal used for TOW_21.
sources.claim: Lou, Polk and Skouras (JFE 2019): the value-weight decile long/short on past-month overnight returns earns a three-factor overnight alpha of 3.47% per month (t 16.83) and an intraday alpha of -3.02% per month (t -9.74); the premia of the strategies studied are earned overnight, with opposite-signed intraday legs.
sources.independent_replication: Akbas et al. 2022 and Lachance 2023 report related persistence; no independent tradability study with costs.
sources.limitations: Uses first-print or official open depending on the data set; no transaction costs; the text states t 16.83 for the three-factor alpha while hypotheses.md cites t 16.6 (raw Table 1 figure); the difference is not material to the frozen gates.

sources.applicability: Sets the ON_5 (one-week) candidate and the second decision cell ON5_P1500_LS.
sources.claim: Aboody, Even-Tov, Lehavy and Trueman (JFQA 2018): stocks in the top overnight-return decile in week w have a significantly higher average overnight return in week w+1 than the lowest decile; the difference is 1.76 percentage points, decreasing but still reliably positive for weeks w+2 to w+4.
sources.independent_replication: Lou-Polk-Skouras 2019 report persistence with different sorting horizon and weighting.
sources.limitations: Equal-weight, includes small and illiquid stocks; no costs; published date is the journal year, month approximate.

sources.applicability: Explains why holding the whole day nets to about zero (the repo's close-to-close cards) and motivates the overnight-only leg.
sources.claim: Akbas, Boehmer, Jiang and Koch (JFE 2022): a higher frequency of positive overnight returns followed by negative trading day reversals during a month indicates a more intense daily tug of war between noise traders overnight and arbitrageurs during the day, and predicts higher future returns in the cross section.
sources.independent_replication: Related to Lou-Polk-Skouras 2019; no independent replication opened.
sources.limitations: Original page blocked by an anti-bot page (Incapsula, 200 with empty body); text read through https://r.jina.ai/ mirror of the same URL. Close-to-close future returns, not overnight-only.
sources.market_and_period: US stocks, long sample per the paper

sources.applicability: Justifies charging borrow for the overnight short leg and treating the last-hour and overnight legs as differently priced.
sources.claim: Bogousslavsky (JFE 2021): margin requirements are higher overnight and lending fees are typically charged only on positions held overnight, which pushes arbitrageurs to reduce positions before the close; a mispricing factor earns positive returns throughout the day but performs poorly at the end of the day, more so in the second half of the sample.
sources.independent_replication: Consistent with Lou-Polk-Skouras 2019 and Akbas et al. 2022.
sources.limitations: Abstract only (EconPapers page); full text is paywalled.
sources.market_and_period: US stocks, long sample per the paper

sources.applicability: Contrast source for the open/close periodicity (queued as T-20260930-13); not a candidate here.
sources.claim: Heston, Korajczyk and Sadka (JF 2010): there is a striking pattern of return continuation at half-hour intervals that are exact multiples of a trading day, lasting at least 40 trading days; short-term reversal is driven by temporary liquidity imbalances lasting less than an hour.
sources.independent_replication: Haendler et al. 2025 report out-of-sample persistence.
sources.limitations: Abstract page read; the paper is about half-hour periodicity, used here only as a contrast.

sources.applicability: Recent evidence that flow-driven open/close patterns persist; background for the auction-execution framing.
sources.claim: Haendler, Heston, Korajczyk and Sadka (SSRN 5749704, 2025): the intra-day periodicity patterns persist out-of-sample; proxies for institutional trading (lendable shares, VWAP-like trading, index inclusion) explain the open and midday periodicity, and the results suggest open periodicity is driven by VWAP trading while close periodicity is driven by market-on-close trading.
sources.independent_replication: Replicates Heston et al. 2010 out of sample by the same authors.
sources.limitations: Abstract page only; working paper, not peer reviewed.

sources.applicability: Supports the 2 bp per side auction cost contract and its 2x stress; warns that the opening leg is the expensive one.
sources.claim: Goyal, Jegadeesh and Wu (JFQA 2026, NYSE and Nasdaq 2012-2021): closing auctions carry about 10% of daily volume and have lower price impact than the continuous market for all stocks except Nasdaq microcaps; opening auctions are illiquid and carry the largest price impact; anomaly long/short portfolios cost 17-41 bp per year.
sources.independent_replication: SSRN 4300417 working paper; no independent replication found.
sources.limitations: Costs annualized for low-turnover anomalies, not a nightly book; institutional-size orders.

sources.claim: Alpaca orders: the cls time in force submits market-on-close and limit-on-close orders that execute only in the closing auction; cls orders submitted after 3:50pm ET and before 7:00pm ET are rejected; opg orders execute only in the opening auction and are rejected after 9:28am ET.

sources.claim: Lachance (Review of Financial Economics 2023, 1995-2021): the past year's overnight return is the most important predictor of future overnight returns, followed by volatility, momentum and turnover; an overnight momentum strategy of picking the top decile of past-year overnight returns yields 37.5% annually versus -18.99% for the bottom decile.
sources.limitations: Original page returned 403 to curl; text read through the https://r.jina.ai/ mirror (full text obtained, not only the snippet). Raw overnight returns, no execution costs.

stop_condition: Frozen in hypotheses.md: decision cell closed if m < 8 bp/night or Newey-West t < 2.0 or placebo beat < 0.90; the pre-specified second cell ON5_P1500_LS (t >= 2.5) is judged the same way; both closed closes the overnight-persistence leg and with it the tug-of-war family. Failure reading: diagnostics (a) and (b) also non-negative means the client-split itself has disappeared in 2024-26. No change to pool, signals, forms, windows, gates or costs after seeing results.
target_regime_and_horizon: Benchmark window 2024-01-08 to 2026-09-29 (main, decision); selection window 2023-09-18 to 2025-12-31, stress period 2016-05-02 to 2023-08-31, contaminated holdout 2026-01-02 to 2026-09-17, new holdout 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-29 (listed only). One-night hold, close auction to next open. A gross-edge measurement; pass licenses official-price sampling, a ledger and a forward shadow from 2026-10-01, not trading. Validity ends if the forward 63-session gross mean falls below the tier threshold.
